name: Florida Active Alcohol Licensees — Bars, Restaurants & Package Stores — 2026 — 52,152 Records (CSV)
summary: Every active Florida alcoholic beverage license for retail venues — 52,152 bars, restaurants, nightclubs, package stores, and specialty retailers. Sourced directly from the Florida DBPR Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco public records, updated regularly. Filtered to on-premise and off-premise retail licensees only (excludes brand registrations, wholesalers, manufacturers).
audience: Liquor distributors and sales reps prospecting on-premise accounts; POS system vendors (Toast, Square, SpotOn) targeting hospitality; payment processors targeting bars and restaurants; linen and supply companies; music licensing reps (ASCAP, BMI, SESAC); entertainment and events vendors; insurance brokers selling liquor liability.
source: Florida DBPR Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco — public records, no auth required (https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/sto/file_download/extracts/bd400lic.csv)
